title: Buddy Bolden known only by talk
summary: Bocage never heard Buddy Bolden but heard much talk of him; Dick relays what Fess told him.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Yeah, I heard, Fess told me about Buddy Bowling being there, I think.
Well, uh, the old Masonic Hall they had here at that time, uh, that was the second horse hall, that was down here on Ballette Street.
Now they got a white Masonic Hall down on, uh, Femuda Street, I think.
Now, did you ever hear Buddy Bowling?
Well, no, I never heard Buddy, but I heard a lot of talk about him. Mm-hmm. But, I never heard him, but I heard a lot of talk about him.
Well, I think he had Frankie Dooson for a while. And I think Frankie Barty, motherly, I think that's what Fess told me.
